patch.summary: Synthesia cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Synthesia pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Basic. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Synthesia cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Synthesia against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Basic until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Basic, Starter, Creator, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when L&D and enablement teams producing talking-head explainers requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 2

items.title: Cost trap 3

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Personal/studio avatars and SCORM sit on higher or Enterprise packaging

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not an LLM assistant, meeting-notes, or coding product
